inputBoundary: One already-derived nonnegative integer app-use count for one user and one app in an explicitly source-aligned 20-week window.
outputBoundary: Exclude an app from the user's app space below two uses and include it at or above two uses; equality is included.
limitations: This binding does not define or identify an application-use event or application identity.
This binding does not group app-use events by user and app or derive use counts.
This binding does not construct, anchor, or slide the 20-week time window; callers must supply that exact window and a mismatched window fails closed.
Distinct-app capacity, gain and loss measures, and window-length sensitivity analysis are separate downstream source operations.
A missing user-app use count fails closed rather than being interpreted as zero.
